title: 第23章 修仙从种地开始第24章 邻居周师姐
content_zh:
听到自己已经是灵霄宗外门弟子了，叶非凡内心长舒一口气。
终于是要在新地图开始练级了，希望在这边能有所提升吧，可别把小命给交代了，对了，以后一定随身带一把小刀，用嘴巴咬手指真疼，这真是血的教训。
“秦执事，那我的具体工作内容是什么呢？我弟子刚加入，也有很多不懂得地方。”
叶非凡向秦月英请教，希望能得到更多得信息。
“你等等。”
秦月英走向自己的座位旁，手放在桌上，能明显的看到一个阵法的亮起。
“李文翰，你马上来我的执事殿。”
说完，手就从阵法中拿起，而阵法也慢慢隐去。
哟，居然还有电话？这功能看起来还很好玩的，以后看能不能搞一个，不过你们都可以打电话了，就不能整出个钟表吗？
看着秦月英的操作，叶非凡老老实实的在一旁站着等候，但内心还是忍不住的吐槽。
过了一刻钟，只见一位年轻人从外面疾步走来，年纪看起来约莫30上下，不过修为只有练气11重左右，明显也是一个外门弟子。
“见过秦执事。”
李文翰一进来就向秦执事拱手。
“这边是刚加入的一个外门弟子，被分配到咱们草药种植殿，叫叶非凡，你把他领去乙九区域去吧，那块种植田都交给他负责。
顺便在跟他讲讲咱们灵霄宗的规矩。”
“是。“
李文翰看了眼叶非凡，立即领命。
“那你们先去吧，叶非凡你就先跟着李文翰，有问题的话可以问问他。“
眼见秦月英已经下了逐客令，叶非凡也道了声是，便跟着李文翰离开大殿。
就在2人即将离开大门的时候，秦月英的声音又传来。

“李文翰，这是内门弟子王琦带过来的人，你注意点。“
“是。“
听到后，李文翰连忙应是。
稍微等待了几息后，明白秦月英没有别的话说了，便带着叶非凡离去。
等离了执事殿有点距离后，李文翰停下脚步，对着叶非凡说道。
“叶师弟，初次见面，我叫李文翰，也是药草种植区域的外门弟子，在这块已经修炼了近10年，对于药草种植区域这部分还是很熟悉的。
你今天刚入门，肯定有很多地方还不明白，可以先问问我，我来帮你讲解讲解“
叶非凡此刻也的确有不少问题想要了解下，就直接开口问道。
“李师兄，咱们这药草种植具体是要做什么工作呢？“
“灵霄宗外门区域分为药草种植区域、初级炼丹区域、矿产采集区域、初级锻造区域、初级阵法区域、初级符文区域、灵兽养殖区域，每一个区域都有一座对应的执事殿，执事殿中最少都有一位筑基期执事坐镇，他们都是灵霄宗正式弟子的身份。
而咱们药草种植区域主要就是负责种植照顾炼丹需要用到的部分药草或者果实。
我们将成熟的药草或者果实上缴给执事殿后，执事殿会给与相应的外门积分，我们可以用这些积分去外门区域的练气楼换取我们日常修炼所需的一些资源。“
听到李文翰的解答，叶非凡点点头，表示明白。
果然是有多位元婴老怪坐镇的大门派，看这外门的区域划分，真的是啥都有，讲的就是一个面面俱到，难怪大哥说我在这里有可能突破到筑基期。
叶家里面的实力还是差太多，对于叶非凡这种普通资质的人来说，是不可能拿出资源去培养的，更何况叶家本身也没有多余的资源。
“听李大哥说外门有初级炼丹区域、初级阵法区域的，难道还有高级的吗？“
对于炼丹阵法这些一听就很牛plus副职业，叶非凡也异常的关注。
“嗯，高级的基本都在内门里面，咱们这些外门弟子是没有资格进去的，高级的炼丹、阵法、炼制法宝、符箓都是要筑基期以上的修士才能胜任，所以只有内门弟子才有机会接触到。
呵呵，你是内门王师兄带进来的，想来叶师弟在外门这里也只是走走过场而已吧。“
对于叶非凡的身份，李文翰很好奇，所以决定稍微打探打探。

“李师兄误会了，我只是一个偶然的机会获得了一份外门弟子的推荐信，所以才有机会加入灵霄宗成为外门弟子的，师兄看我这练气6重的修为就知道了，要是没有那封推荐信，我可能连成为外门弟子的机会都没有。
至于王师兄，那更是没有什么关系，只是这份推荐信是王师兄的，所以他才负责把我带过来而已，在这之前，王师兄根本就不认识我。“
虽说从情感上讲，叶非凡很希望跟李文翰说，对，老子就是王琦带进来的，拿的还是他师傅洪长老的他推荐信，就问你怕不怕，慌不慌。
content_en:
Ye Feifan breathed a sigh of relief when he heard that he was already an outer disciple of Lingxiao Sect.
It’s finally time to start leveling up on the new map. I hope I can improve here, but don’t risk your life. By the way, I will carry a knife with me from now on. It hurts to bite my fingers with my mouth. This is a bloody lesson.
"Deacon Qin, what is the specific content of my work? My disciple has just joined and there are many things he doesn't understand."
Ye Feifan asked Qin Yueying for advice, hoping to get more information.
"You wait."
Qin Yueying walked to her seat, put her hands on the table, and could clearly see a formation lighting up.
"Li Wenhan, come to my deacon's hall immediately."
After saying that, he picked up his hand from the formation, and the formation slowly disappeared.
Oh, you actually still have a phone? This function looks very interesting. I’ll see if I can get one in the future. But since you can make phone calls, can’t you make a clock?
Seeing Qin Yueying's operation, Ye Feifan stood aside and waited obediently, but he still couldn't help complaining in his heart.
A quarter of an hour later, a young man was seen walking quickly from outside. He seemed to be about 30 years old, but his cultivation level was only about 11th level of Qi training, and he was obviously an outer disciple.
"I've met Deacon Qin."
As soon as Li Wenhan came in, he handed over to Deacon Qin.
"Here is an outer disciple who has just joined. He is assigned to our Herb Cultivation Hall. His name is Ye Feifan. You can take him to the Yijiu area. He will be responsible for the planting field.
By the way, I was telling him about the rules of our Lingxiao Sect. "
"Yes."
Li Wenhan glanced at Ye Feifan and immediately accepted the order.
"Then you go ahead. Ye Feifan, follow Li Wenhan first. If you have any questions, you can ask him."
Seeing that Qin Yueying had issued an order to expel guests, Ye Feifan said yes and followed Li Wenhan out of the hall.
Just when the two were about to leave the door, Qin Yueying's voice came again.
"Li Wenhan, this is the person brought here by inner disciple Wang Qi. Please pay attention."
"Yes."
After hearing this, Li Wenhan quickly responded.
After waiting for a few breaths, she understood that Qin Yueying had nothing else to say, so she took Ye Feifan away.
After waiting some distance away from the Deacon Hall, Li Wenhan stopped and said to Ye Feifan.
"Junior brother Ye, this is the first time we meet. My name is Li Wenhan. I am also an outer disciple in the herb cultivation area. I have been practicing here for nearly 10 years and I am still very familiar with this part of the herb cultivation area.
You are just getting started today, and there must be many things you still don’t understand. You can ask me first and I will explain it to you.”
Ye Feifan did have a lot of questions that he wanted to know at the moment, so he asked directly.
"Senior Brother Li, what exactly does our herb cultivation do?"
"The outer area of Lingxiao Sect is divided into medicinal herb cultivation area, primary alchemy area, mineral collection area, primary forging area, primary formation area, primary rune area, and spiritual beast breeding area. Each area has a corresponding Deacon Hall, and there is at least one foundation-building deacon sitting in the Deacon Hall. They are all official disciples of Lingxiao Sect.
Our herb planting area is mainly responsible for growing and taking care of some of the herbs or fruits needed for alchemy.
We will hand over the mature herbs or fruits to the Deacon Hall, and the Deacon Hall will give corresponding outer sect points. We can use these points to go to the Qi Training Building in the outer sect area to exchange for some resources we need for daily practice. "
After hearing Li Wenhan's answer, Ye Feifan nodded to express his understanding.
As expected, it is a sect with many Yuanying old monsters sitting in charge. Looking at the area division of this outer sect, it really has everything. It is about covering everything. No wonder the eldest brother said that I can break through to the foundation building stage here.
The strength within the Ye family is still far behind. For a person with ordinary qualifications like Ye Feifan, it is impossible to devote resources to training, let aloneWhat's more, the Ye family itself has no extra resources.
"I heard from Brother Li that there is a primary alchemy area and a primary formation area in the outer sect. Are there also advanced ones?"
Ye Feifan was also extremely concerned about the alchemy formations and sub-professions, which were very impressive at first glance.
"Well, the advanced ones are basically in the inner sect. We outer sect disciples are not qualified to enter. Advanced alchemy, formations, magic weapon refining, and talisman are all capable of being practiced by monks above the foundation stage, so only inner sect disciples have the opportunity to come into contact with them.
Haha, you were brought in by Senior Brother Wang from the Inner Sect. I guess Junior Brother Ye was just going through the motions here at the Outer Sect. "
Li Wenhan was very curious about Ye Feifan's identity, so he decided to inquire a little bit.
"Senior Brother Li misunderstood. I just got a recommendation letter from an outer sect disciple by chance, so I had the opportunity to join Lingxiao Sect and become an outer sect disciple. Senior brother saw that I am at the sixth level of Qi training. Without that recommendation letter, I might not even have the chance to become an outer sect disciple.
As for Senior Brother Wang, it doesn't matter. It's just that this letter of recommendation belongs to Senior Brother Wang, so he was responsible for bringing me here. Before this, Senior Brother Wang didn't know me at all. "
Although from an emotional point of view, Ye Feifan really wanted to tell Li Wenhan, yes, I was brought in by Wang Qi, and I got a letter of recommendation from his master, Elder Hong, so I asked you if you are afraid or not panicked.
